svg.title: FIFO operation
svg.desc: Animated 16-entry FIFO. Entries are written until full, one extra write is ignored, then entries are read and written so the pointers wrap; count, EMPTY and FULL flags and the first-word-fall-through rd_data track the state.
svg.text: used twice: TX FIFO and RX FIFO (same parameters)
empty = (wr_ptr == rd_ptr) · full = (wr_ptr[4] ≠ rd_ptr[4]) & (wr_ptr[3:0] == rd_ptr[3:0]) · the extra MSB flips on every wrap
Pointers are $clog2(DEPTH)+1 bits wide, so DEPTH must be a power of two (elaboration-time $error otherwise).
